scoring: likelihood x impact (1-5); >=15 red blocking at G2; 8-14 amber QC-monitored; <=7 green

assumptions.text: listed failure modes occur at non-trivial rates in generative candidates (industry-observed; unmeasured for selected model until G2 batches exist)
24 fps 180-degree shutter feel achievable natively or via rejection (CAP-08 UNVERIFIED)
silhouette shots are lower identity-risk but higher physics-risk; face shots inverse

measurement_plan: at G2 record observed failure rates per risk from batch results; update likelihood scores with evidence; register is living
blocking_rules: any red risk observed in a candidate rejects it regardless of rubric score
hard-stop risks: single confirmed instance rejects candidate and triggers prompt/plate remediation before next batch
